approaches.label: White patches and rows of teeth make a skull-like face against black. Thin red and pale outlines repeat around its head and shoulders, unsettling the apparent grin. The image can read as confrontational or darkly comic.
approaches.strength: Specific looking language, with uncertainty about emotion.
approaches.limit: Cannot establish technique, stroke counts, archival dates or a defensible position in the collection.

approaches.label: Recorded on February 8, 2022, the drawing contains 26 recorded strokes and 15,283 sampled points on a 742.05 × 742.05 logical canvas. Repeated lines outline a white, skull-like face against black, with red marks at the eyes and around the head.
approaches.limit: The paragraph reads like a data caption; exact canvas precision and point totals crowd the visual reading. Stroke count can be mistaken for effort.

approaches.label: White patches assemble a skull-like face, while red and pale outlines keep its edges unsettled. The teeth are drawn as repeated loops rather than one solid band, making the grin feel insistent. The black ground removes distractions. It can read as confrontational or darkly comic; the image does not fix a single emotion.

recommendation: Use the three-layer label as the editorial format. Keep full technical data available on demand. Compute facts and relationship candidates before the AI drafts interpretation; review links against both images.
